title: NomadNet (the Stump as a Nomad Network node and RRC hub)
summary: NomadNet and MeshChat browse the Stump like any Nomad Network node, over Wi-Fi or LoRa: its home page, its rooms (read, and say something), the billboard (read, and post) and the list of shared files. And NomadNet's own chat (Channels) joins the Stump's rooms live: the Stump is an RRC hub, its rooms the hub's rooms, both ways with the web, FireFly and LXMF. Writing takes an identity the app proves. A card on the Stump's home page gives both addresses.
hooks: node nomadnetwork.node: /page/index.mu rooms.mu room.mu say.mu board.mu notice.mu files.mu
node rrc.hub: RRC sessions (HELLO, JOIN, MSG, ACTION, PART, PING; /list, /who)
every 1 s: the rooms' new lines and DMs out to each RRC session
every NOMADNET_ANNOUNCE_MIN minutes (30): announces the node and the hub, with the Stump's name

runtime_storage.note: Nothing stored: the pages show the Stump's own rooms, billboard and files.

prompts.prompt: Minutes between NomadNet announces (5 or more)
